hardware.q: How does Heidi Remote protect my data?
a: Heidi Remote is designed with privacy at its core. It only records when actively initiated by the User, and a visible LED indicates when recording is in progress, ensuring transparency for all parties. All audio is encrypted at rest on Heidi Remote and is automatically deleted once synchronised to the Heidi platform. Heidi Remote connects only to the User's paired device via an encrypted wireless connection. Users are responsible for obtaining all required recording consents under applicable law in their jurisdiction.

hardware.q: What is Heidi Remote compatible with?
a: Heidi Remote currently pairs with the Heidi iOS mobile app (from v3.0.0), Android (v3.3.0) and Desktop App (v2.0.0). Once connected, Remote transcriptions are automatically synced into Scribe sessions. Remote is not currently compatible with web application of Heidi (e.g. when accessing Heidi through your web browser).

hardware.q: What happens if my Heidi Remote is lost or stolen?
a: Your transcriptions are encrypted at rest and in transit. If your device is lost or stolen, transcriptions cannot be accessed by someone else. Contact Support via online chat or email support@heidihealth.com for help.

hardware.q: What if my battery runs out mid-session?
a: Your transcriptions are safe. Sessions remain saved on the device and will sync once you recharge and reconnect.

hardware.q: What happens if I move away from my phone or my internet drops out mid-consult?
a: No problem — we’ve got you covered! Heidi Remote is designed to perform in high-mobility roles and poor connectivity environments. If you go out of range or lose internet connection, Heidi Remote switches to offline mode and keeps recording. When you reconnect, it syncs automatically.

hardware.q: Can multiple people share one Heidi Remote?
a: Heidi Remote is designed for one user at a time. To share it, the device must be fully unpaired from the current account and then re-paired to a new one. Though you must be aware that unpairing permanently deletes any recordings stored on the device that have not synced yet.

hardware.q: Does Heidi Remote keep recordings forever?
a: No. Audio is stored on-device temporarily and is automatically deleted once synchronised to the Heidi platform.

hardware.q: How long does the battery last, and how do I charge it?
a: Heidi Remote supports around 12–14 hours of continuous transcribing. Charge via USB-C, which is also included when you receive your Heidi Remote.

hardware.q: What is included in the box?
a: Your Heidi Remote comes with the device, a magnetic clip, a USB-C charging cable, a detachable lanyard, quick start guide and printed setup documentation.

The core purpose of an AI scribe is to automatically generate clinical notes from patient encounters. However, additional features medical trainees may benefit from include specialty-specific note templates, automated document generation (referral letters, medical reports, meeting minutes), and the ability to rapidly summarize patient history. A well-designed AI scribe for medical trainees, like Heidi, minimizes administrative burden while enhancing learning opportunities. This is achieved by providing junior doctors with gold-standard note templates, facilitating more hands-on experience by reducing documentation time, and minimizing the admin-related stress and pressure that negatively impact trainee well-being.

Once the session is over, press Stop transcribing, and Heidi generates a perfectly structured note in seconds, along with any additional documents that may be required. Customize Heidi’s outputs by choosing from popular progress note templates like SOAP, DAP, and BIRP. Or, browse the Template Community for more specialized templates, such as head-to-toe assessment, operative notes, and chronic care management plan. Our Medical Knowledge team reviews all templates within Heidi for accuracy and clinical utility. As a result, Heidi works as a supportive tool for medical trainees, helping junior doctors to progressively become more familiar and confident with gold-standard documentation formats.

solutions-medical-trainees.q: Why is Heidi the best AI scribe for medical trainees?

However, several advanced features make it stand out as the best AI scribe for medical trainees. Firstly, Heidi offers unparalleled customization to get your notes exactly right. For example, if your consultant or attending likes a note or document structured in a particular way, you can customize your template to match their preferred format and style. Secondly, Heidi is more than just a point-of-care transcription tool. The Context field within Heidi supports adding non-verbal background information in any format (from typed observations to medical reports and even photos of hand-written notes). Heidi draws this contextual information into outputs, producing rich, detailed notes that draw from the patient’s entire history. For clinicians working with culturally diverse populations, Heidi supports accurate transcription in over 30 languages. Outputs like patient instructions or an after visit summary can be translated into any supported language, enhancing follow-up care.

In the future, doctors of all levels can look forward to AI medical scribes evolving into comprehensive clinical assistants. Just some of the tasks AI scribes will assist with in the future include coding, billing, and simple patient follow-up. As the best AI scribe for medical trainees, Heidi is committed to supporting junior doctors in utilizing AI in a way that benefits clinicians, patients, and the wider community.

impact.q: Can an AI scribe make mistakes?
a: Yes, and every clinician using one should expect it. AI scribes can misinterpret what was said, add findings that were never stated, or occasionally miss context from a busy or noisy visit. With Heidi, that is why every note waits for you before it goes anywhere. You read it, change what needs changing, and sign off. The AI drafts. The call is always yours.

impact.q: Do I need to tell my patients that Heidi is transcribing the visit?
a: Yes, and it is good practice everywhere. More than a dozen US states require all parties to consent before a conversation is recorded. Beyond the legal side, 81% of patients say they want to be told an AI scribe is in use and asked for consent before the visit starts. A brief, plain-language explanation at the start of the appointment is all it takes. Heidi transcribes the visit to draft your note, it does not store the audio afterward, and patients can opt out at any time. Patient Consent Forms are also available in Heidi’s Resource Centre.

impact.q: Will an AI scribe replace the clinician?
a: No. Heidi drafts the note. You make every clinical decision. The AI cannot examine a patient, weigh up competing diagnoses, or notice that something feels off in the room. What it can do is take the documentation off your plate so you can do those things without a keyboard in the way. That is the distinction between an AI Care Partner and a replacement, and it is why the call is always yours.

impact.q: What happens to the audio after Heidi transcribes the visit?
a: Heidi transcribes the visit to draft your note, and the audio is not retained afterward. Patient data is not used to train the model without appropriate consent and de-identification controls. Heidi operates under a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and meets HIPAA, GDPR and regional compliance requirements. For the full picture, visit the our Safety and Compliance page.

safety.q: Can Heidi access my patient’s information?
a: Short answer, no. Before Heidi processes your session, we strip all data of personal identifiers (think ‘Jane Doe’ instead of the patient’s name), so it can’t be traced back. Your patient’s data remains protected and Heidi does not and will not contact your patients for any purposes.

No, Heidi does not store any audio. As you speak, Heidi types, and the audio immediately goes *poof*. Even if you’re uploading an audio file that was recorded offline, the audio is only stored on your device, and Heidi doesn’t retain any of it once it’s been transcribed.

safety.q: Where are Heidi’s servers storing my data?
a: Locally. Heidi’s “brain” (aka servers) stays strictly in the region you’re based in, keeping everything in line with data localisation requirements under regulations like GDPR.

safety.q: How does Heidi mitigate data breaches?
a: Step 1: Prevention. Heidi implements the best in class infrastructure - think ISO27001, SOC2 and Cyber Essential compliant, while also being penetration tested every year. The architecture of our data storage also ensures that your protected health information (PHI) is de-identified and processed separately to the rest of the transcript. The reality is though, we have to be prepared for anything, and so all of our users, free or paid, are insured and receive the highest standard of compliance.

resources-faq.q: How long does a safety plan take to complete?

You not only halve the time you spend on the screen, you also get to restore the human element in patient care.

resources-faq.q: Is a safety plan the same as a treatment plan?
a: No. A safety plan is a crisis-focused tool designed to help an individual manage overwhelming emotions. A treatment plan covers a broader scope of care, as it sets the diagnosis, roadmap of goals alongside interventions for the patient. Clinicians often use both together to provide a plan of action that’s geared towards the betterment of the client.
